meta.purpose: Recommended reading order, phase-grouped, with the opening quartet pinned first.
meta.note: This is NOT chronological order, and it is not a flattening of the chart either. The chart's lanes are parallel storylines, so cross-lane vertical position implies no reading order. Phases are anchored on in-universe date, and the curated order is preserved within each phase.
meta.violationNote: A violation means the phase ordering places a book before something the chart says should precede it. These are surfaced in the interface on the affected book rather than silently reordered.

phases.title: Start Here
phases.blurb: Four books, in this order. They are the entry point to the whole saga, and almost everything else assumes you have read them.

phases.title: Before the Betrayal
phases.blurb: The Great Crusade, the Primarchs found, and the grievances that will become the Heresy.

phases.title: Isstvan and the Drop Site Massacre
phases.blurb: The betrayal breaks into the open. Isstvan III, then the ambush at Isstvan V.

phases.title: Calth and the Shadow Crusade
phases.blurb: The war spreads. Ultramar burns and the traitor Legions carve up the east.

phases.title: Imperium Secundus and the Ruinstorm
phases.blurb: Cut off behind the warp storm, the loyalist Primarchs build a second Imperium.

phases.title: The Road to Terra
phases.blurb: Beta-Garmon and the last campaigns before the Warmaster reaches the Throneworld.

phases.title: The Siege of Terra
phases.blurb: The finale. Read these last, and read them in series order.

phases.title: Optional: The Primarchs
phases.blurb: Seventeen character studies, one per Primarch. Supplementary background rather than plot, absent from the source chart, and readable any time after the opening four.
